text: Lewis treats a time traveler who meets her younger self as a four-dimensional 'person-worm' whose distinct temporal parts (stages) are co-present at a single external time. The metaphysics of persistence on which objects have distinct temporal parts existing at different times is called ___.
explanation: The expected answer is perdurantism (four-dimensionalism), the view that persisting objects have distinct temporal parts; it handles the meeting-yourself case cleanly, since the 30-year stage and the 70-year stage are numerically distinct parts of one worm and can be spatially co-present without contradiction. Its rival, endurantism (three-dimensionalism), holds that the object is wholly present at each time and therefore faces the problem of one thing being wholly present in two places at once.
